title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: monthly maintenance fee and waiver thresholds by tier
content:
## Scope

This quick reference gives, for every tier of Savings & Money Market Accounts, the monthly maintenance fee and the value of each waiver the tier offers. A waiver marked "not offered" does not exist on that tier and cannot be used there.

## What each column means

- **Monthly maintenance fee**: the fee assessed at statement cycle close unless a waiver is met, in USD.
- **Minimum daily balance waiver**: the lowest end-of-day balance during the cycle at or above which the fee is waived, in USD.
- **Automatic transfer waiver**: an automatic transfer from checking of at least this amount posted in the cycle waives the fee, in USD.
- **Age waiver**: the fee is waived while the owner is younger than this age, in whole years, at cycle close.
- **Linked checking waiver**: holding an active checking account of one of the listed tiers at cycle close waives the fee.
- **Relationship balance waiver**: the relationship balance at cycle close at or above which the fee is waived, in USD.

## Tier table

| Tier | Monthly maintenance fee | Minimum daily balance waiver | Automatic transfer waiver | Age waiver (younger than) | Linked checking waiver | Relationship balance waiver |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter Savings | USD 5.00 | USD 300.00 | USD 25.00 | 25 | not offered | not offered |
| Statement Savings | USD 5.00 | USD 300.00 | USD 25.00 | not offered | Interest Checking, Premier Checking, Private Client Checking | not offered |
| Goal Builder Savings | USD 0.00 | not offered | not offered | not offered | not offered | not offered |
| Money Market Account | USD 12.00 | USD 2500.00 | not offered | not offered | Premier Checking, Private Client Checking | USD 15000.00 |
| Premier Money Market | USD 20.00 | USD 10000.00 | not offered | not offered | Premier Checking, Private Client Checking | USD 25000.00 |
| Private Client Money Market | USD 25.00 | USD 100000.00 | not offered | not offered | Private Client Checking | USD 250000.00 |

## The same table read tier by tier

- **Starter Savings** offers three waivers: minimum daily balance, automatic transfer and age.
- **Statement Savings** offers three waivers: minimum daily balance, automatic transfer and linked checking.
- **Goal Builder Savings** offers no waiver; its fee is USD 0.00.
- **Money Market Account**, **Premier Money Market** and **Private Client Money Market** each offer three waivers: minimum daily balance, linked checking and relationship balance. None of them offers the automatic transfer or age waiver.

## Points of judgement

**An owner of a Money Market Account holds an active Interest Checking account. Does that tier's linked checking waiver apply?** No. The Money Market Account lists only Premier Checking and Private Client Checking; Interest Checking is not among them.

**Can the automatic transfer waiver be used on a Premier Money Market account?** No. It is not offered on that tier, so no amount of automatic transfers meets it there.

**Which tiers accept Everyday Checking for the linked checking waiver?** None; no tier lists Everyday Checking in this column.
